_comment: Golden DEFAULT-INPUT outputs per calculator, asserted by .github/workflows/calc-smoke.yml. On load with default inputs, each calculator's rendered body text MUST contain every string listed for it — this catches a 'computes the WRONG number' regression that the NaN/undefined checks miss (e.g. DCF silently returning $35 instead of $31.48). Values captured 2026-06-08 from the live render and verified present in body.innerText for all 16. If you DELIBERATELY change a default input or a formula, re-capture the affected calculator's output and update its array here; the test failure message points back to this file.
